_comment: Notes the build planner shows while a build guide's template is loaded unchanged. Keyed by build id (the file name in src/content/builds). 'text' is shown as written. Optional 'missingWeapons' lists weapons a guide uses that aren't in standard-weapons.json yet, as [name, slot]: write the weapon's name in the plannerHash (for example w2s=P90) and the planner fills that slot as soon as a weapon with that name exists; the note only mentions the ones still missing.

tactical-pharma-season-2-build-ggreborn.text: GGReborn doesn't say which two pieces are Fire Cycle, so this uses TikTokAndy's split from the same guide: body armor and holster.

aegis-team-healer-tech-operator-build-ti.text: The guide doesn't say which two of backpack, gloves and holster are Mechanical Expert; this puts it on gloves and holster.

any-weapon-commando-beginner-vanguard-bu.text: The guide doesn't say which of the last two pieces is the holster; this puts the Phalanx Attack piece there.

lightweight-m4-commando-vanguard-build-t.text: TikTokAndy doesn't say which two pieces are Gunny Johnny in this video, so this uses the mask and body armor from his October 6 build. He also calls Suppressive Fire II his backpack talent here; this follows his earlier videos and our talent lists, which put it on the body armor and Emergency Measures on the backpack.
